CommunityApplications.Profile:
Share Name Normalizer previews and bulk-renames Unraid user shares to lowercase, hyphen-separated names (e.g. "TV Shows" -> "tv-shows"), with a full preview, collision checks, service-state checks, a flash-drive backup, and best-effort automatic rollback. This repository contains the single Share Name Normalizer plugin.
Support and bug reports: https://github.com/RayMunro/unraid-share-name-normalizer/issues
